title: Release Workflow V1
objective: Harden the tag-only four-platform release workflow for signed macOS, Linux x64/arm64, explicitly unsigned Windows, immutable artifacts, checksums, provenance, and fail-closed publication

handoff.summary: The tag-only GitHub release authority now separates release-candidate rehearsal from stable publication, pins every byte-influencing action and Node 26.7.0, consumes checksum-bound platform artifacts, verifies strict archive member allowlists, signs and notarizes only the protected macOS input, labels Windows explicitly unsigned, and assembles exactly four artifact IDs and digests into a private draft as the final operation. The strict publication assembler is GitHub-only and fails closed on duplicate, traversal, unexpected, or mismatched inputs. Focused workflow and publication policy tests passed 13 cases and the source authority received independent review.
risks: Linux producer jobs remain explicitly provisional until the reviewed baseline-to-SEA producer interface supplies their final archive filenames and readiness receipts.
No release tag was created and no artifact was published by this source integration.
next_steps: Resolve only the provisional Linux producer blocks after integrating the shared baseline-to-SEA authority.
Run a release-candidate tag rehearsal before approving a stable tag.
